ValidationRule.description: When Span Type is Partial (Hours), internal numeric duration must be 1–8 (normally set from the Span Duration dropdown).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Span_Type__c, "Hours"), NOT(ISBLANK(Span_Duration__c)), OR( Span_Duration__c < 1, Span_Duration__c > 8 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Partial (Hours), choose a duration from 1 to 8.
